inputs.name: renderGuide.guide
inputs.description: A Guide supplies topic, summary, steps, rules, antiPatterns, and exampleCommands; contains is optional. Text fields are interpolated verbatim, and list entries become one bullet each.

outputs.name: renderGuide
outputs.description: The returned Markdown places the topic heading and summary before the Steps, optional Contains, Rules, Anti-patterns, and Example commands lists. List entries are prefixed with -, the rendered headings remain in this order, and the result ends with a newline.
examples:
# Local rendering

Render the guide as Markdown.

## Steps
- Read the guide data.
- Call renderGuide.


## Contains
- A topic heading.
- Section lists.


## Rules
- Keep section order.


## Anti-patterns
- Return HTML.


## Example commands
- npm run dev
